meta.name: security-mobile-masvs
meta.description: Review native iOS and Android applications against OWASP MASVS and MASTG-aligned mobile security controls: local storage, cryptography, authentication, network communication, platform interaction, WebViews, code quality, app signing, anti-tampering, privacy, root/jailbreak assumptions, and release-store constraints. Use before any native mobile release, after changes to authentication, storage, networking, WebView, deep links, permissions, signing, or SDK dependencies, and alongside security-owasp-web for mobile backend/API surfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查移动应用，发现安全漏洞与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在发布 iOS/Android 应用前需要检查安全合规。
copy.tagline_en: Review mobile apps to find security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify security compliance before releasing an iOS/Android app.

howto.what: 你会变成移动安全发布闸门:按 OWASP MASVS 审查原生 iOS/Android 应用的本地存储、加密、认证、网络、WebView、签名等,产出风险清单、状态表和放行/有条件/阻止结论。
howto.when: 在原生 iOS/Android 应用发布前,或当你提到要审查认证、存储、网络等变更时触发。

say.text: 按 OWASP MASVS 审查这个安卓 APK,给出放行结论。
say.note: 会跑检查清单并给出结论。

say.text: 检查 iOS 应用的钥匙串、ATS 和深链授权是否达标。
say.note: 会针对 iOS 平台做专项检查。

say.text: 发布前评估本地存储加密和防篡改,列出风险和整改负责人。
say.note: 会指出不达标项并给出整改方案。

howto.what_en: Becomes a mobile security release gate: reviews native iOS/Android apps against OWASP MASVS/MASTG (storage, crypto, auth, network, WebViews, signing), outputs an attack-surface inventory, per-family status table, platform-specific findings, and a Go/Conditional/Hold verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a native iOS/Android release, or when changes to authentication, storage, networking, and similar areas are mentioned.

say_en.text: Review this Android APK against OWASP MASVS and give a release verdict.
say_en.note: Runs the checklist and proposes a triage.

say_en.text: Check iOS keychain, ATS, and deep-link authorization compliance.
Assess local storage encryption and anti-tampering before release; list risks and owners.
